summary: Specify remote MCP OAuth access: daemon-owned grants, trusted-surface consent, audience-bound opaque tokens, allowlisted clients, and R1-gated activation

replay.detail: Documentation only; no claims, projections or replay behavior change.

schema.detail: The OAuth section specifies a future typed approve/deny operation; no wire schema or generated clients change.

rules.detail: No admission or checkpoint rule changes; R1 keyed-writer admission remains a prerequisite.

compatibility.detail: No runtime change. The spec preserves stdio/loopback credential-file mode and defines remote per-request bearer authentication without fallback.

downtime.detail: No daemon, adapter, tunnel or grant is deployed or mutated.

manual.detail: No operator action is authorized by this spec. R1, bearer checks at use, OAuth, and non-loopback exposure remain ordered gates; grant and assistant writes remain frozen until R1 is deployed and verified.

recovery.detail: Documentation only; no live state requires recovery.
